appearance.subtle: There is a dressing showing at their collar.
appearance.obvious: Open sores weep along their forearms and neck, crusted at the edges.
appearance.extreme: They are covered in running sores from the jaw down, and the smell arrives before they do.

description: Open lesions that never quite heal. Purely cosmetic. Purely awful.
drawbacks: Visibly diseased, so NPCs react poorly
name: Weeping Sores
